summary: Implemented the feature without running any tests or repository code, and without committing. Files changed: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver: save, save_batch, finalize with overwrite-false merge) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver: save, save_batch, private static _create_file_basename); monai/data/nifti_writer.py default dtype changed to np.float32; monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py gained plot_2d_or_3d_image; the segmentation and classification handlers now hold a saver and delegate (classification registers an engine-accepting wrapper around finalize); tensorboard_handlers.py TensorBoardImageHandler gained index and delegates to the plot function. output_path was renamed to output_dir in two segmentation examples and the sliding-window integration test. Tests added: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py now passes filename. Static checks only: no lines over 120 characters, no trailing whitespace, correct file endings, no stale output_path references. flake8 was not run, and none of the tests have been executed. Not covered: no test for the TensorBoard handler index parameter, and no documentation updates.
